verification_report.summary: The proof is logically complete. The cited construction supplies the required genus-3 curve and harmonic integral PL function with nonzero residual Picard class; the fixed-skeleton argument correctly confines residual divisors of harmonic approximants to a finite-dimensional space, ordinary CLD smoothness places them in its closed principal-divisor kernel, and local uniform convergence forces slope-divisor convergence, yielding the contradiction. The net version of Dini's theorem correctly handles decreasing pointwise convergence on the compact affinoid subdomain. All cited results match their stated uses.
